answer: Start with one small rule: cap each identity at two graded answers per epoch and let trust edges decay 3 percent a day. A web of 30 real partners then outperforms a vault of 3,000 clones, because clones add no edges that survive decay and earn two answers each, while every edge is a vine that needs fresh work to stay alive. Idle accounts bleed standing, and a single whisper of a forged edge costs the branch.
